context.description: Numeric equality does not establish identity in ownkb:namespace:openwebnet

label: Numeric equality does not establish identity
text: Equal numbers or matching labels in independent protocol, catalogue, implementation, and application namespaces do not establish identity or a join.

context.description: Identity is not address in ownkb:namespace:openwebnet

label: Identity is not address
text: An installed Device ID, diagnostic WHERE, and functional WHERE have distinct roles; none may be substituted for another merely because observed values resemble each other.

context.description: slot is not Module or address in ownkb:namespace:device-model

label: slot is not Module or address
text: A slot is the numeric position that locates a Module; it is neither the Module itself nor the Module's configured functional address.

context.description: Capability is not runtime state in ownkb:namespace:device-model

label: Capability is not runtime state
text: Catalogue capability describes what a Device or firmware can support; diagnostic and functional observations describe installed or runtime state and must not be silently substituted for capability.

label: WHERE is system-specific
text: Resolve the interface variant and WHO before interpreting WHERE; no single universal address grammar applies to every OpenWebNet system.

context.description: Configuration requires resolved context in ownkb:namespace:device-model

label: Configuration requires resolved context
text: A configuration index or value is meaningful only in its resolved Device, firmware, Module, Object, ownership, and operation context.

context.description: Public specification and implementation can differ in ownkb:namespace:openwebnet

label: Public specification and implementation can differ
text: Differences between published protocol documents and versioned implementation artifacts must remain explicit source or version differences, not be silently reconciled.

context.description: Source counts are not protocol limits in ownkb:namespace:openwebnet

label: Source counts are not protocol limits
text: Counts measured in a particular database revision describe that source revision and are not universal protocol maxima or complete product-family counts.
